tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Returns a page of Magic Prices UK products for a free-text query (productId, name, brand, best price in GBP, offerCount, rating, url) with brand and category facets and the price range. Covers the whole catalogue by keyword (e.g. "iPhone 15"); productId in the results is the identifier accepted by the product tools. Inputs: q from the user; brand = names from the brands facet; categoryId from the categories facet or find_category.

brand.description: Brand names (not ids), comma separated, from the brands facet.

categoryId.description: Numeric categoryId to restrict the search, taken from the `categories` facet or from find_category.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one Magic Prices UK product sheet: identity, best price in GBP with discount, plain-text summary, specs by theme (max 40 rows), editorial pros and cons, variants, the 5 cheapest offers, refurbished availability, coupons and url. Inputs: exactly one of productId or ean; includeSpecs false skips the specs.

productId.description: productId from search_products or any product list.

tools.name: get_product_offers
tools.description: Returns all store offers for one Magic Prices UK product sorted by totalPrice (price plus delivery) in GBP, with store (e.g. Argos), availability, delivery, marketplace flag and url, plus offerCount, minPrice and maxPrice. Inputs: productId from a previous result; condition, page and size are optional.

productId.description: productId from search_products or any product list.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Returns the best-price history of one Magic Prices UK product in GBP: stats (min, max, avg, first, last, dataPoints, minDate, maxDate) and a {date, price} series (daily up to 90 days, weekly beyond). Inputs: productId; days 7 to 730 (default 180).

productId.description: productId from search_products or any product list.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Returns a side-by-side comparison of 2 to 4 Magic Prices UK products of the same category: product summaries with best price in GBP and spec rows by theme (the rows that differ plus the first ten shared ones). Inputs: productIds from search_products, get_similar_products or get_category_products.

items.description: productId from search_products or any product list.

productIds.description: 2 to 4 distinct productIds of one leaf category.

tools.name: get_similar_products
tools.description: Returns products similar to one Magic Prices UK product (same category) as summaries with best price in GBP, offerCount, rating and url. Inputs: productId from search_products or get_product.

productId.description: productId from search_products or any product list.

tools.name: analyze_price
tools.description: Returns a buying recommendation for one Magic Prices UK product: current best price in GBP, position in the price history (near the historical low, mid range, near the high), recent trend, a verdict (buy_now, wait, neutral, unknown) with its reasons and a confidence level, plus an optional comparison with a price you saw elsewhere (externalPrice, optional externalStore). productId comes from search_products.

productId.description: productId from search_products or any product list.

externalPrice.description: Price in GBP seen outside Magic Prices UK, to compare with the market.

externalStore.description: Name of the store where externalPrice was seen (for example Argos).

tools.name: find_category
tools.description: Returns up to 10 Magic Prices UK categories matching a name (leaves first), with slug, parent path and isLeaf. The slug of a leaf is the identifier accepted by get_category_products. Input: a category name in the site language.

query.description: Category name in the site language (e.g. "Smartphones"); case and accent insensitive.

tools.name: get_category_products
tools.description: Returns one page of products of a Magic Prices UK category (price in GBP, price range, offers, rating, image, url), with the top brands, the price range and the total. minPrice and maxPrice restrict the page to a budget; sort accepts rating, price_asc, price_desc, created_desc. slug from find_category; brandId from a brands facet.

brandId.description: brandId from a brands facet, to keep one brand.

tools.name: get_brand_products
tools.description: Returns one page of products of a brand on Magic Prices UK (price in GBP, price range, offers, rating, image, url), with the brand, its main categories and the price range. brandId from a brands facet; categoryId from find_category.

brandId.description: brandId from a brands facet (search_products, get_category_products, get_deals).

categoryId.description: categoryId from find_category or this tool's categories, to keep one category.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Returns one page of products discounted on Magic Prices UK by at least the given percent versus their highest current price (price in GBP, highPrice, discountPercent, image, url), with the categories and brands of the deals. categoryId from find_category; brandId from a brands facet.

discount.description: Minimum discount percent versus the highest current price: 5, 10, 15, 30 (default 15).

categoryId.description: categoryId from find_category, to restrict to one category.

brandId.description: brandId from a brands facet, to restrict to one brand.

tools.name: get_promo_codes
tools.description: Returns one page of coupon codes and store promotions listed on Magic Prices UK (code, title, description, type, store, endDate), site-wide or for one store. storeId from an offer or get_store; store is a name or slug.

store.description: Store name or slug (e.g. "Argos"), case and accent insensitive; ignored when storeId is given.

storeId.description: storeId from an offer or get_store; preferred when known.

tools.name: get_store
tools.description: Returns the profile of a store listed on Magic Prices UK: website, type, city, payments, deliveries, shipping cost and threshold, return policy, logo and rating. storeId from an offer; slug or name from an offer or the user.

storeId.description: storeId from an offer or get_promo_codes. Give storeId or slug, not both.

slug.description: Store slug or name (e.g. "Argos"); a name is normalised to its slug.

tools.name: get_store_deals
tools.description: Returns the products a store highlights on Magic Prices UK (productId, name, price in GBP, oldPrice when known, url, image). storeId from an offer; slug or name from an offer or the user.

storeId.description: storeId from an offer or get_promo_codes. Give storeId or slug, not both.

slug.description: Store slug or name (e.g. "Argos"); a name is normalised to its slug.
